content.text: [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/digital-product-stores-kyc-payments-what-actually-how-6|digital]] creators in Zimbabwe face significant challenges when it comes to establishing an online store. Conventional payment platforms like Stripe or PayPal are often unavailable, leaving creators without a viable way to monetize their digital products. This landscape necessitates a reliable [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-crypto-payment-gateways-digital-products-7|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] that not only processes payments efficiently but also grants complete ownership of the digital store. The Edge Commerce Stack provides a comprehensive solution, leveraging Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and NOWPayments to create a sovereign commerce framework that works effectively in restricted environments. In this analysis, we will explore the merits of deploying a digital store using this stack, addressing real-world concerns surrounding ownership, payment processing, and [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-2|The Real]] choice.
What Each Option Actually Offers

In contrast, Stack 01, based on GitHub Pages, offers a simpler deployment but at the cost of less flexibility and scalability. It relies on Google Apps Script to handle backend logic, which can be limiting for more complex operations. While both stacks provide a way to set up a digital storefront, the Edge Commerce Stack stands out with its enhanced capabilities, designed specifically to cater to the needs of creators who require robust performance in challenging environments.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

On the other hand, the GitHub Pages option, while functional, may not provide the same level of support for restricted environments. The reliance on Google Apps Script could pose complications in regions where Google services are not entirely stable or accessible. Additionally, creators using this stack may still find themselves needing to navigate complex workarounds to receive payments, limiting its effectiveness in truly restricted scenarios.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

In contrast, the payment processing speed and cost implications for GitHub Pages users may vary significantly. Depending on the integration chosen for payment processing, there could be delays in confirming transactions. Furthermore, reliance on traditional payment methods may incur higher fees and longer processing times. The Edge Commerce Stack provides a streamlined and efficient payment process that caters to the needs of creators who cannot afford delays or excessive fees.
The Edge Commerce Stack empowers creators to reclaim their sovereignty in digital sales.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

In comparison, the GitHub Pages solution may not offer the same level of autonomy. While it allows for the creation of a digital store, the reliance on third-party services can introduce complications regarding data ownership and delivery. Creators may find themselves tied to the limitations of the tools they choose, which could hinder their ability to scale or pivot their business model as needed.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If simplicity and quicker setup time are paramount, Stack 01 could be sufficient for creators with a limited number of products and basic needs. However, for those looking to build a more substantial online presence with the potential for growth, the Edge Commerce Stack is the recommended choice. By investing in this architecture, creators position themselves for success in a digital landscape fraught with challenges.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

For digital creators in Zimbabwe seeking to deploy a digital store effectively, the Edge Commerce Stack is the optimal solution. It combines powerful infrastructure components that ensure ownership, efficient payment processing, and scalability. By utilizing Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, creators can establish a sovereign online presence that meets their unique needs without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
Launch your digital store without the constraints of traditional payment systems.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is designed specifically for creators looking to navigate the challenges of restricted online commerce. This integrated solution not only facilitates rapid deployment but also ensures that every aspect of the store is optimized for performance and ownership, enabling creators to focus on what they do best.
Your Deployment Checklist

To successfully deploy your digital store using the Edge Commerce Stack, follow these steps: First, set up a Cloudflare account and create a new Pages project. Next, configure your Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, ensuring that you can manage requests and integrate with Supabase for data storage. Afterward, set up your NOWPayments account to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Load your digital products into Supabase, and ensure your store is properly configured for automatic delivery upon payment confirmation. Finally, test your deployment in a mainnet environment to confirm smooth operation before promoting your digital store to your audience.
Frequently Asked Questions
What payment methods does the Edge Commerce Stack support?
The Edge Commerce Stack supports over 300 cryptocurrencies through NOWPayments, allowing creators to receive payments without relying on traditional banking services.
How quickly can I set up my store with the Edge Commerce Stack?
The Edge Commerce Stack can be deployed in just 48 hours, providing a rapid pathway for creators to launch their digital storefronts.
Will I own my customer data with the Edge Commerce Stack?
Yes, creators retain full ownership of their customer data and digital products, ensuring complete control over their online store.
Are there any ongoing fees after deploying my store?
No, there are no ongoing fees or subscriptions after deploying your store with the Edge Commerce Stack. You pay a one-time fee for deployment.
Is technical expertise needed to use the Edge Commerce Stack?
While some technical knowledge is beneficial, the Edge Commerce Stack is designed to be user-friendly, allowing creators to navigate the setup process effectively.
